title: STRANGE MINUTE #13 · WHAT IF

lines.text: What if you texted Voyager 1 right now?
lines.say: What if you texted Voyager One right now?

lines.text: This week it set a record no machine ever has.
It's now one light-day from Earth.
Your text flies at the speed of light...
and it still takes a whole day to get there.
Its answer? Another whole day back.
So one hi and hi back takes two days.
lines.say: So one hi, and hi back, takes two days.

lines.text: It launched in 1977. Almost 50 years ago.
lines.say: It launched in nineteen seventy-seven. Almost fifty years ago.

lines.text: Now it's 16 billion miles out, flying 38,000 miles per hour.
lines.say: Now it's sixteen billion miles out, flying thirty-eight thousand miles per hour.

lines.text: Its radio has about the power of a fridge light bulb.
And giant dishes on Earth still hear it.
It even carries a golden record, in case aliens find it.
So, what would YOU text Voyager?
lines.say: So, what would you text Voyager?
